analysisResults.questionText: Do you have a process for identifying and managing ICT vulnerabilities?
Do you have a process for managing ICT security incidents?
Do you have an ICT risk management framework in place?
Do you perform regular ICT risk assessments?
Do you have business continuity and disaster recovery plans?
Do you have documented ICT risk management policies and procedures?
Do you have contractual agreements with third-party ICT providers?
Do you have exit strategies for critical third-party ICT services?
Do you have a process for assessing third-party ICT risks?
Do you monitor and review third-party ICT service providers?
Do you use ICT third-party service providers?
Do you have an ICT incident management framework?
Do you have procedures for detecting ICT incidents?
Do you have procedures for reporting ICT incidents to competent authorities?
Do you maintain an ICT incident log?
Do you have procedures for post-incident review and lessons learned?
Do you perform regular ICT resilience testing?
Do you perform vulnerability assessments and penetration testing?
Do you perform scenario-based testing (e.g., cyber attack simulations)?
Do you have a testing schedule and documented test results?
Do you test your business continuity and disaster recovery plans?
Do you participate in information-sharing arrangements on cyber threats?
Do you share cyber threat intelligence with other financial entities?
Do you notify competent authorities of your participation in information-sharing arrangements?
